Keywords: bold claim controversial contrarian counter intuitive surprising statement
Example: Most people build their LinkedIn profile completely wrong. Here's what actually works.
Why It Works: Triggers curiosity and mild disagreement — both make people keep reading to see the proof.

Keywords: curiosity gap tease incomplete information mystery suspense want to know
Formula: [Tease outcome without revealing how] / 'Here's what happened...' / 'The result surprised me'
Example: I tried posting every day on LinkedIn for 90 days. The result was not what I expected.
Why It Works: The brain hates incomplete loops — creates an itch that must be scratched by reading on.

Keywords: number list statistic data surprising fact specific
Example: 73% of LinkedIn posts get zero engagement. But not these 7 types.
Why It Works: Numbers signal specific value and set expectations. '7 types' promises a structured, digestible post.

Keywords: question open loop curiosity engage audience self-identify
Formula: [Question that makes your audience think YES or makes them curious]
Example: Are you building your social media audience the slow way?
Why It Works: Self-qualifying hook — people who answer 'yes' immediately feel seen and keep reading.
